productive_waiting_rule: While the five sibling lanes run in the background, Aletheon must research, prepare, propose next tasks, harden runners, and produce next-phase planning artifacts before phase advancement.

sources.title: Unlocking the Codex harness: how we built the App Server
sources.takeaway: Codex App Server exposes the Codex harness as a client-friendly JSON-RPC event surface with thread, turn, and item lifecycles. THOS should use status receipts and completion gates around these primitives instead of treating launch as proof.

sources.title: Using Codex with your ChatGPT plan
sources.takeaway: Codex capabilities and access can vary by plan and workspace controls. THOS should keep live readiness checks and avoid assuming that a previously available surface remains available.

sources.title: MCP security best practices
sources.takeaway: Consent, redirect/state validation, token audience, least privilege, local-server caution, and confused-deputy defenses map directly into THOS connector and app-lane policy.

sources.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform scaling documentation
sources.takeaway: Agent scaling documentation reinforces explicit runtime isolation, sandboxing, identity, evaluation, tracing, and durable state boundaries. THOS watcher runners should mirror those controls locally via receipts and gates.
